description:
Delegate reasoning-heavy, context-heavy, or parallel work to isolated subagents. Each has its own conversation, terminal and tools; only its final summary returns. Use execute_code for mechanical batches and direct calls for single tools. Children cannot ask the user questions.

Required results return in this tool call by default. Use completion_policy='deferred' only when this answer does not need the results. Without a later-result consumer (including one-shot CLI and cron), even deferred calls wait and return results. Otherwise deferred calls return transcript paths and completions arrive BETWEEN turns (one message per call). Finish independent work, then END YOUR TURN. Never wait or poll transcripts, artifacts or CI for deferred children. Use action=list/steer/stop for live control, or action=continue for a finished child.

Running children stop on /stop, /new or process exit, with interrupted completions and partial output. Saved child conversations can be continued after restart. Use cronjob or terminal(background=True, notify=True) for durable execution.

- Pass all needed context, including output language, tone and style; children have no conversation history.
- Summaries are self-reports. For external side effects, require a URL, ID or absolute path and verify the result yourself before claiming success.
- Children return findings, not tracked-work closures; the parent applies the transition.
- Children cannot call delegate_task, clarify, memory, or cronjob.
- Children inherit the parent model unless pinned via delegation.provider / delegation.model in config.yaml.
name: delegate_task

action.description: Default 'spawn'. Live control of running children: 'list' = ids/goals/status/transcripts; 'steer' = queue course-correction text into one child without stopping it; 'stop' = end one child early (partial result still returns); 'continue' = give a FINISHED child a follow-up: it resumes its own conversation and returns like a spawn. Control actions return immediately; tasks are ignored unless spawning.

completion_policy.description: Whether this answer requires the result. 'required' (default) waits in this tool call; 'deferred' returns immediately and delivers a later completion turn. Orchestrator children always wait for their own workers so they can synthesize the result.

message.description: Required for action='steer': the course correction, appended to the child's next tool result mid-run. Be directive and specific. For 'continue': the child's next instruction.

subagent_id.description: Required for action='steer'/'stop'/'continue' (ids from the spawn response or action='list').

tasks.description: Required for spawn: one entry per child, up to 10 in parallel (delegation.max_concurrent_children). Use a one-entry array for a single task.

context.description: Background THIS child needs: file paths, error messages, constraints. Each child sees only its own context — repeat shared background in every task that needs it.

goal.description: What this subagent should accomplish. Be specific and self-contained.

images.description: Images this child must SEE (max 8): local file paths or http(s) URLs — e.g. a screenshot the user sent, a design mock, a chart. Vision-capable children receive the pixels on their first turn; non-vision children get path hints for vision_analyze. Text files do NOT belong here — put paths in 'context' instead.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema this child's final answer must validate against (told to the child up front; parent validates with one bounded correction retry; result gains schema_valid, plus schema_errors on failure — the child's raw text is still returned as summary, never discarded). Keep it forgiving — require only fields you will read.
